description: This file defines the final class ProjectInfo within the Drupal package_manager module, responsible for retrieving and managing project update information, including available releases, installed version, and support status, interacting with Drupal's update and extension systems.

classes.name: ProjectInfo
classes.description: A final class that provides methods to retrieve and evaluate project update information within Drupal's package management system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ProjectInfo object with the project name.

methods.name: isInstallable
methods.description: Determines if a given project release can be installed based on security, publication status, support, and branch support.

methods.name: getProjectInfo
methods.description: Retrieves up-to-date information about the project, including update data.

methods.name: getInstallableReleases
methods.description: Returns an array of project releases that are installable and newer than the current installed version.

methods.name: getInstalledVersion
methods.description: Gets the current installed version of the project as known to the Update Status module.

methods.name: getAvailableProjects
methods.description: Fetches all available project data, including from the update system or package manager.

methods.name: isInstalledVersionSafe
methods.description: Checks if the installed project version is secure, supported, and published.

methods.name: getSupportedBranches
methods.description: Returns the list of supported branches for the project.
